# A test's own write of its instance's state redraws what reads it, as a
# handler's does: `c.label`, a style's `c.pad`, a push to the list a `for`
# walks, and page state. passReactivity follows each with a call of the
# owner's `__wrote_<v>`, which runs the updates a handler's write of v runs
# (design/testing.md). Before, the write landed on the Model's field or the
# page's `state` and nothing redrew; and a page var a node reads, written in a
# test, did not build on fyne or gtk4, its updates inlined into the test file
# naming a node it has none of (`undefined`).
#
# `app.sngl` writes and snapshots; `shown.sngl` is built showing what was
# written, and the two must be one picture on every target.

mkdir html fyne gtk4
env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

cp app.sngl html/app.sngl
cp shown.sngl html/shown.sngl
sngl test --platform=html html/app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html html/shown.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
grep '<span id="\$0" data-sngl-id="t">b</span>' html/app.sngl.snapshots/shown.html
grep 'padding: 8px;' html/app.sngl.snapshots/shown.html
grep '<span>y</span>' html/app.sngl.snapshots/shown.html

cp app.sngl fyne/app.sngl
cp shown.sngl fyne/shown.sngl
sngl test --platform=fyne fyne/app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne fyne/shown.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
cmp fyne/app.sngl.snapshots/shown.png fyne/shown.sngl.snapshots/shown.png

cp app.sngl gtk4/app.sngl
cp shown.sngl gtk4/shown.sngl
sngl test --platform=gtk4 gtk4/app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 gtk4/shown.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'
cmp gtk4/app.sngl.snapshots/shown.png gtk4/shown.sngl.snapshots/shown.png

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var page = "p"

component card ui.node {
    var label = "a"
    var pad ui.measurement = 0px
    var items = ["x"]
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text #t(value=label)
        ui.text(value=page)
        ui.vbox(style={padding=pad, background=#336699}) {
            ui.text(value="padded")
        }
        for var i = items {
            ui.text(value=i)
        }
    }
}

func testWritten(t test.Test, c card) {
    c.label = "b"
    c.pad = 8px
    c.items.push("y")
    page = "q"
    t.snapshot("shown")
}

ui.window {
    card
}
-- shown.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var page = "q"

component card ui.node {
    var label = "b"
    var pad ui.measurement = 8px
    var items = ["x", "y"]
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text #t(value=label)
        ui.text(value=page)
        ui.vbox(style={padding=pad, background=#336699}) {
            ui.text(value="padded")
        }
        for var i = items {
            ui.text(value=i)
        }
    }
}

func testWritten(t test.Test, c card) {
    t.snapshot("shown")
}

ui.window {
    card
}
